Legend

The citizens of the recently discovered city of Rathleton require assistance in defending their civilization against various threats.

Location

Oramond, Rathleton

Dangers

Mooh'Tah Warrior, Worm Priestess, Minotaur Hunter, Blood Beast, Minotaur Amazon, Moohtant, Execowtioner, Rustheap Golem, Metal Gargoyle, Glooth Golem, Walker, Glooth Anemone, Devourer, Rot Elemental, Glooth Blob, Glooth Bandit, Glooth Brigand, Humongous Fungus, Hideous Fungus, Warlock, aswell as several other creatures.

Reward

Earn voting points which can be used in the Rathleton Quest within the Rathleton Magistrate.

History

The missions and tasks within the Underground Glooth Factory were introduced after the initial quest, coinciding with the 2014 Winter Update.

Requirements

Missions:

  • Lyre (for Glooth Bandits)
  • Special Flask (Holy Water) (for Glooth Bandits)
  • 20 Pieces of Crocodile Leather (for The Gloud Ship)
  • 10 Shrimp (for The Gloud Ship)

Tasks:

  • 10 Glooth Capsules, or both 10 Tainted Glooth Capsules and either Filled Glooth Converter or Strange Device (for Glooth Capsules, note that Strange Device and Filled Glooth Converter are rewards of Mutated Glooth Plague mission)

The following missions/tasks take place in the Underground Glooth Factory and thus cannot be completed without the Citizen rank of the Rathleton Quest:

  • Glooth Bandits (mission)
    • Nature's Balance (task)
  • Mutated Glooth Plague (mission)
  • The Gloud Ship (mission)
    • Milking Spiders (task, see footnote 1)
    • Cooking Gloo (task, see footnote 1)
    • Gassing Up
  • Glooth Capsules (task)
  • Tending Gloothworms (task)
  • The Gloud Ship Tasks (task)

Footnotes:

  1. The Milking Spiders and Cooking Gloo tasks do not require access to the Underground Glooth Factory and are possible on the mission that unlocks them before access is available. However, the final objective of the mission, Gassing Up, requires access to the Underground Glooth Factory. Thus, repeating the task is impossible without the Citizen rank.


Tips

The tasks are supposed to be additional objectives to complete while normally playing the game. However, some players will want to focus on points to use the features that are available to high-ranked citizens. The following tasks are reasonably completable during a hunt:

  • The Powder of the Stars
  • To Take Roots

The following tasks are the fastest to complete for votes:

  • Communication Breakdown
  • Combinatorics (requires strong coordination)
  • The Ancient Sewers
  • Cooking Gloo (requires Citizen rank and The Gloud Ship mission)

The following tasks are kill-tasks and require almost no effort outside of usual hunting:

  • Taking the Rot Out
  • The Minor Taurs
  • The Name Of The Beast
  • Nature's Balance

The following task has limited repeats per day and is impractical for farming:

  • Tending Gloothworms (Calibrating the Irrigation Funnels, Feeding the Worms, Rake Away)

The following task could be completed to buy your way through voting points assuming the items are available:

  • Glooth Capsules (requires Citizen rank and Glooth Bandits and Four Demanding Statues mission)

The following tasks are simply not worth the hassle just for the points:

  • Probing
  • Rathleton Turnip Party
  • Sabotage
  • Dr. Merlay's Misery

Missions

Each mission can be completed once following the descriptions in this section. However, many of these missions will unlock corresponding tasks, allowing you to revisit and repeat specific parts of the mission to earn additional voting points.

The Glooth Bandits

To begin "The Glooth Bandits" mission, start by speaking with Elbert, who can be found here (33586, 31986, 12). When you speak with him ask him about a Mission; he will enlist your help in investigating a recent surge in glooth bandit attacks.

Your task is to retrieve 10 Glooth Capsules, which have been stolen by the Glooth Bandits and Glooth Brigands. You can obtain these capsules by hunting Glooth Bandits and Glooth Brigands or by purchasing them through The Market or from a friend. It's important to note that Elbert will not accept Tainted Glooth Capsules. If you happen to loot Tainted Glooth Capsules, you can use a Filled Glooth Converter acquired in the course of the Oramond Quest - The Mutated Glooth Plague to purify them into Glooth Capsules.

Report back to Elbert to complete this mission, you will earn 2 voting rights in the Rathleton Magistrate. If you have more than 10 Glooth Capsules, you will receive 2 additional voting rights for every 10 capsules you hand in. Requires completing Four Demanding Statues mission before turning in Glooth Capsule.

Four Demanding Statues























Browse Map (33548, 31963, 12)
Locations of Dinky Moss Floret

Requirements:

  • You've achieved the rank of Citizen by casting a total of 300 votes.
  • A Lyre which can be found here (33579, 31906, 12) or purchase one from Fayla in Rathleton.
  • A Dead Rat which can be found here (33579, 31940, 12), here (33545, 31979, 12), here (33481, 31991, 12), and here (33385, 31927, 12).
  • Gathered 3 Dinky Moss Florets.
  • A flask of Holy Water purchased from Henricus in Thais.

To begin the "Four Demanding Statues" mission, start by speaking with Elbert, who can be found here (33586, 31986, 12). When you speak with him ask him about a Mission in which he will ask you to help find the bandits' hideout, in order to find out who is behind the attacks. You can find the hideout's entrace here (33514, 32025, 12), which is to the south-west of the Slime Slide which brought you into the Underground Glooth Factory. Go up the hole then follow the short path to the south where you will go down a hole arriving within the strange large room.

Show Text
You read the following.
"I discovered a buried temple or shrine, that must once have been part of a much bigger complex. I don't know what ancient culture could have built this nor whether it was a sanctuary, palace or something completely different. The main part of these ruins is a small place, accurately built of black and white tiles. In the centre is a big black stone figure, surrounded by four different statues. Each of them has an inscription, which gives a hint on what the statue wishes. I assume if one can fulfil all four wishes, something will happen, yet I don't know what this 'something' could be. I also noticed that the inscription on one of the statues became unreadable over time. Based on an old legend I assume, the last request could be: 'Adorn me.' "

Descending deeper into this strange room you will come accross 4 statues, an Angel Statue to the North, a Sacred Statue to the East, a Cobra Statue to the South, and a King Statue to the West. You must find a way to Bless, Adorn, Feed, and Entertain the statues. In this room you will also find a Dead Explorer found here (33563, 32021, 12).

  • Start by positioning yourself infront of the Angel Statue to the North. Now use the Holy Water you purchased from Henricus in Thais on the statue. If you have successfully Blessed the Angel Statue you will receive the following message:
    Mysteriously the statue comes to life, nodds generously and spreads its wings. Then it turns back into its lifeless state.
  • Continue by positioning yourself infront of the Sacred Statue to the East. You must now create a Dinky Moss Floret Garland. All around the eastern mushroom area (33697, 31997, 12) you will have found Dinky Moss Florets on the mountain walls, use these to obtain Dinky Moss Florets. When you've gathered 3, use one of the Dinky Moss Florets on another Dinky Moss Floret to create a Interwoven Moss Floret. Now use another Dinky Moss Floret on the Interwoven Moss Floret to create a Dinky Moss Floret Garland. Finally, use the Dinky Moss Floret Garland on the statue to adorn it, ensure that you've turned off the flame on the statue first by using the statue. Failure to turn off the flame will result in the Dinky Moss Floret Garland being destroyed when you use it on the statue! If you have successfully Adorned the Sacred Statue you will receive the following message:
    Mysteriously the statue comes to life, stretches out its arm and takes the flowers. Then it turns back into its lifeless state.
  • Proceed by positioning yourself infront of the Cobra Statue to the South. Use the Dead Rat on the Cobra Statue to feed it. If you have successfully Fed the Cobra Statue you will receive the following message:
    Mysteriously the statue comes to life, bends its head and devours the offered meat. Then it turns back into its lifeless state.
  • Finally position yourself infront of the King Statue to the West, using a Lyre play it infront of the statue. Upon successfully Entertaining the King Statue you will receive the following message:
    Mysteriously the kingly statue comes to life, smiles slightly and nodds generously. Then it turns back into its lifeless state.
Show Text
You read the following.
"My esteemed colleague,

we are very pleased to hear that your activities near Rathleton are flourishing. To be honest, at first we were more than suspicious as we learned that you are hiring a gang of criminals and have them do the more inconvenient tasks for you. But seemingly you are able to keep away from them the important information about your actual goals and intentions. Furthermore your succes in establishing a makeshift laboratory in the tunnels under Rathleton and even acquiring some novel glooth based weaponry speaks for itself. The mutated glooth you mentioned in your last letter is an interesting matter. Perhaps it is useable in an arcane way to enhance spells or improve potions. Even the creation of yet unknown artefacts could be possible. We think your endeavours are taking a good path.

With best regards
Uquora the High-Handed of the Circle of the Black Sphinx"

Now that you have animated all four statues, you may enter the Magic Forcefield in the center. Upon entering, you will be teleported to a room on the floor above you, where you will encounter more Glooth Bandits and Glooth Brigands. Head to the far eastern part of the cave to locate a Warlock around here (33632, 32045, 11). You must kill the Warlock and once you've done so walk around the room until you receive the following message:
Has the warlock been behind the glooth bandits' assaults? Most likely, but you need a proof. Isn't there a letter in the shelf?

Finally, in the North-East corner of the room open the bookshelf here (33636, 32036, 11) to get a parchment with the text shown to the side.

Report back to Elbert, upon greeting him your mission will be completed and you will get 4 voting points in the Rathleton Magistrate.

Obtain a Dead Rat from a Heap of Rubbish.
Search the Bookcase to find the warlock's letter.
Bless the statue with Holy Water.
Adorn the statue with a Dinky Moss Floret Garland.
Feed the statue a special Dead Rat.
Entertain the statue by playing a Lyre.

The Mutated Glooth Plague

Show Text
You read the following.
Scientific Research Report by Georgia Rainbird:

Three months ago I discovered it for the first time: A strange kind of glooth, deep purple in colour and of a slightly different consistency than the glooth variant we knew until now. There are some pools or ponds of this glooth in the upper mushroom caves in the east of the tunnels. At the time of my researches these were the only ones, but I fear they are spreading. I assume, it is a kind of mutation that caused the glooth to change this way. I was very careful about my researches as I don't yet know all possible side effects of this mutated glooth variant. What I was able to determine is the following: The mutated glooth is a dangerous thing. It affects its environment in a clearly negative fashion. Some plants wither and rot under its influence, others mutate into toxic, sometimes even animated variants. Smaller cave dwellers as rats, toads and bugs are likewise affected by the side effects of the mutated glooth. They also evolve into poisonous, bigger and stronger variants of themselves. They show an increased aggressiveness and seem to infect other animals with their bite. These first observations lead me to believe that the glooth mutation down here has to be stopped. If it spreads out the danger for Rathleton or even Oramond could be immense.

Requirements:

  • 5 Bronze Gear Wheels these can be looted from Glooth Golems, Metal Gargoyles, and Rustheap Golems.
  • 1 Copper Valve can be obtained by using a Copper Valve.
  • 1 Calibrated Indicator Gauge found in the box here (33394, 31915, 12).
  • 1 Glass Tube received by asking Elbert about a Glass Tube after starting the mission.
  • 1 Strange Device supplied by Georgia Rainbird once accepting the mission.

To begin this mission, approach Georgia Rainbird located here (33585, 31906, 12). Ask her for a mission by using the keywords Hi - Mission - Yes - No. Upon your request, she will supply you with a Strange Device and instructions regarding the specific items required to assemble a Glooth Converter.

Finding the Calibrated Indicator Gauge
Demounting a Copper Valve
Obtaining the Glass Tube

After obtaining the Strange Device from Georgia Rainbird and having gathered the required items, proceed by using the Bronze Gear Wheels, Copper Valve, Calibrated Indicator Gauge, and Glass Tube on the Strange Device. Completing this process will result in the creation of a Glooth Converter.

You mount the gear wheels on the broken device. But it doesn't seem complete yet.
You mount the valve on the broken device. But it doesn't seem complete yet.
You mount the indicator gauge on the broken device. But it doesn't seem complete yet.
You mount the glass tube on the broken device. Now it seems to work.

To continue, speak with Georgia Rainbird once again, she will inform you that she needs an antidote to eliminate the harmful influence of the mutated glooth. To do this you will need to gather a Crimson Crest Mushroom, these can be found throughout the Underground Glooth Factory. You are likely to find them here (33476, 32001, 12), here (33685, 31884, 12), and here (33717, 31876, 12), among other areas around the Purple Slime. To collect a Crimson Crest Mushroom, all you need to do is use the Crimson Crest Mushroom. Keep in mind that it takes 5 minutes for them to regrow after being picked.

Now you must go make your way back to Georgia Rainbird's laboratory and use the Crimson Crest Mushroom on the Alchemical Apparatus to create a Vial of Mushroom Distillate. Now you will need to use the Vial of Mushroom Distillate on the Glooth Converter to finish creating a Filled Glooth Converter.

You will now need to use the Filled Glooth Converter on eight pools of Purple Slime. To use it effectively, use it similarly to a fishing rod. Aim for the center of the pools to avoid obstruction by the ground borders near the edges. Once you've completed this procedure eight times, the Filled Glooth Converter will break, leaving you with a Strange Device, 5 Bronze Gear Wheels, a Copper Valve, a Calibrated Indicator Gauge, and a Glass Tube. With these components, you can easily restart the task by reconstructing the device. Use another Vial of Mushroom Distillate on it to finish rebuilding the Filled Glooth Converter.

Once you've completed the mission speak with Georgia Rainbird to receive 5 rights to vote in the Rathleton Magistrate.

Notes:

  • You can request a replacement Strange Device by saying Lost Glooth Converter to Georgia Rainbird.
  • You can collect a Calibrated Indicator Gauge every 2 minutes.
  • You can request a replacement Glass Tube from Elbert by asking about a Glass Tube.
  • Requesting replacement items can only be done if you're carrying them.
  • You can create multiple Filled Glooth Converters, allowing you to use one for the quest and one for cleansing Tainted Glooth Capsules.
Use a Crimson Crest Mushroom to obtain a Crimson Crest Mushroom.

The Gloud Ship

Find Zeronex by going to the harbour and walking around the city wall to find a Ladder (here (33616, 31990, 6)). Go up the ladders to reach the top and walk a little north.

Talk to Zeronex about the incident and accept the mission with yes. He will send you to Nicholas Cavendish to obtain a Strong Cloth.

Strong Cloth

Go to Nicholas inside Upper Rathleton. He is located above the post office, here (33640, 31897, 5); to reach him, you must use the Ladder (Oramond) on the south side of the building. Nicholas will ask you for 20 Pieces of Crocodile Leather in return for secret information. Give him the Crocodile Leather and ask again about the very strong cloth. Nicholas will create Strong Cloth for you if you bring him the material required.

First, Nicholas requires 15 pieces of Steel Spider Silk. To get them, you must find special Steel Spiders which crawl around many Rathleton landmarks. Note that you must find the spiders, not Spider Webs. It is recommended to go to the Glooth Factory (here (33543, 31930, 7)) as it has a higher spider density, but you can find them in the Rathleton Sewers and possibly other places as well. Use the Milking Fork that Nicholas provided on the Steel Spiders. Note that some "spiders", even around Rathleton, which look similar are actually Something Crawling which cannot be used.

With much care, you extracted some steel spider silk.

When you have obtained 15 pieces of Steel Spider Silk, you must find a Yarn-Winding Machine and use the Steel Spider Silk on the Yarn-Winding Winch to make a Spool of Steel Silk Yarn. You can find one on the west side of the Workshop Quarter, here (33614, 31960, 7).

You have spun the yarn on a spool. Now you can weave a cloth.

Now go to the room below Zeronex and use your Spool of Steel Silk Yarn with a Weaving Loom to obtain Strong Cloth. The following message will appear:

You have woven a fine strong cloth.
Use the Milking Fork on the Spider to obtain Steel Spider Silk (15x).
Use the Steel Spider Silk on the Yarn-Winding Winch to obtain Spool of Steel Silk Yarn.
Use the Spool of Steel Silk Yarn on the Weaving Loom to obtain Strong Cloth.

Bottle of Airtight Gloo

Go back up the ladder and talk to Zeronex. He will take the Strong Cloth from you and instruct you to speak with Yeo about obtaining strong glue, or gloo. Find Yeo by the Rathleton harbour and exchange the 10 Shrimp for a Bottle of Gloo.

Now you must concoct a Bottle of Airtight Gloo. To do so, go to the Rathleton pharmacy. It is located in the western part of the Rathleton Workshop Quarter, west of the stairs (here (33609, 31949, 7)). On the second floor, open the Bookcase to obtain Glooth Farina. Go up the stairs again and open the northern Bookcases to obtain Pink Gloud Essence and Glooth Vinegar. You may not need all of these items or you may need more of them. If you need more of an item after using the one you obtain, you can open the respective Bookcase to obtain another one.

Now that you have the ingredients, find a Glooth Cauldron. Conveniently, there are a few located just east of the pharmacy (here (33622, 31945, 7) and upstairs). Use the Bottle of Gloo on a cauldron and a message appears:

<gloop> <gloop gloop>

Now you must use the Glooth Cauldron until you obtain the Bottle of Airtight Gloo. If you receive one of the following server messages then you must perform something else before continuing to use the cauldron:

The concoction is too thick. Liquefy it with glooth vinegar.

—Use Glooth Vinegar on the Glooth Cauldron.

The concoction does not stick! Sequester it with glooth farina.

—Use Glooth Farina on the Glooth Cauldron.

?

—Use Pink Gloud Essence on the Glooth Cauldron.

You have retrieved some glooth plasma. Maybe you should shake it to see if it settles down?

—Use Glooth Plasma. A few things can happen:
The mix decomposes. Try to cook up some gloo at the cauldrons again.
—You obtain Rubbish and lose the Glooth Plasma. Continue using the Glooth Cauldron.
Nothing happens. Maybe if you shook it a little more?
—Nothing happens. You can use the Glooth Plasma again.

If you require more of the three items, you can receive more from the pharmacy after using the ones you took.

When you are done, you will have received the message:

You have retrieved some airtight gloo.

Report back to Zeronex about your mission. He will give you an Airtight Cloth to keep, and a Gas Bag for your next mission.

Optional side-mission: Zeronex will give you Airtight Cloth if you ask for it. You can give 6 Airtight Cloths to the NPCs within Rathleton: Yeo, Nicholas, Barazbaz, Alaistar, Fayla and Christine will accept Airtight Cloths. When you hand one in to each of these NPCs, you will receive the achievement Publicity.

Obtain a Bottle of Airtight Gloo by repeatedly using the Glooth Cauldron and following the prompts.

Filled Gas Bag

Your next mission is to go to Zeronex's laboratory and fill his Gas Bag. The laboratory is in the Underground Glooth Factory. Go to the Underground Glooth Factory by entering the Slime Slide in the building by NPC Terrence who is east of the stairs to Upper Rathleton. Go to the furthest west-southwest of the cave to find Zeronex's laboratory, here (33396, 31982, 12).

When you find Zeronex's laboratory, use the three Glooth Data Machines that are against the walls. You must use the east side of the machines repeatedly until the calibration is complete for that machine. You will receive the following server messages when you're done with that machine, not necessarily in this order:

+++ 01 REPORT --- CALIBRATION COMPLETE --- VALUES IDEAL +++
+++ 02 REPORT --- CALIBRATION COMPLETE --- VALUES IDEAL +++
+++ 03 REPORT --- CALIBRATION COMPLETE --- VALUES IDEAL +++

Now you can use the Gas Bag on the Glooth Data Machine in the center of the laboratory. When you do so, your Gas Bag will become a Full Gas Bag and you will receive the following message:

You fill some of the gloud into the gas bag.

Go back to Zeronex and report about your mission. You can leave the Underground Glooth Factory by entering the Slime Slide near where you appeared on entry.

You will receive 3 voting points for completing this mission and you can now accept 3 daily tasks.

Use these machines.
Use Gas Bag on this machine.

Tasks

You may complete tasks as many times as you'd like. While certain tasks may have daily limits, others do not impose any such restrictions.

Combinatorics

You can initiate this task through Doubleday, but it's not mandatory, as the task automatically activates when you eliminate specific monsters in the Rathleton New Sewers. Voting rights can accumulate rapidly in this task. Once you've slain 9 creatures in the correct order, you'll start building a Consecutive Chain for every additional 3 creatures you defeat in the correct sequence you'll gain an additional voting right.

To proceed, venture into the Rathleton New Sewers and kill monsters in the sequence indicated by your quest log or server log. The eligible creatures for this task are:

  • Glooth Golem
  • Devourer
  • Glooth Anemone

As you eliminate each correct creature, your streak increases. Beware that killing the wrong creature will reset your consecutive chains to zero. If you're not aiming for a high score or attempting to achieve the 10 consecutive chains required for the achievement, it's advisable to periodically report your progress to avoid losing it due to a single mistake. The number of Consecutive Chains recorded in your quest log can later be exchanged for voting points through Doubleday. To report your progress, speak with Doubleday using the keywords Hi - Combinatorics - Yes. When you're ready to exchange your chains for voting points, use the keywords Hi - Exchange - (Enter Number) - Yes. Your rewards will be awarded as voting points in the Rathleton Magistrate.

Note, the unpredictable dynamic spawns within Rathleton New Sewers make it challenging to anticipate where specific creatures will appear.

Upon successfully completing 10 consecutive chains within a single task, you'll earn the Combo Master achievement.

Communication Breakdown






































Browse Map (33649, 31950, 9)

Massive Generators

To begin the communications task, locate Doubleday in the Workshop Quarter here (33640, 31961, 6). Speak to him about his communication problem which arose using the following keywords Hi - Communications - Yes. Doubleday will mark a Sewer Grate location on your map.

Head southwest from Doubleday's building and venture under the docks. You'll find a Sewer Grate here (33621, 31979, 7) that will take you two floors down to here (33622, 31979, 9). Be prepared to encounter Glooth Anemones, Glooth Golems, and Devourers in this area. It's advised to bring along Fire Wall Runes, Fire Bomb Runes, or Fire Field Runes to block the Glooth Anemones, Glooth Golems, and Devourers from reaching you.

Note: To ascend back to the surface, you must use the base of the rungs in the wall as you would any Ladder.

In the sewers, your objective is to locate one of the Massive Generators. On the floor you're currently on, there are a total of 3 generators; one to the east (33664, 31984, 9), which is closest, and two to the north here (33622, 31961, 9), and here (33615, 31929, 9). When you locate one, use one of the two Slimy Valves found to the south of the Generator. When using the valve Coloured Steam will appear over your character, and orange text will display above the valve, indicating the colour of the steam released, such as "Yellow steam emerges...". Use the valve 3 times while noting the colours of the steam each time.

For example, if you receive the following texts when using the Slimy Valve:
Violet steam emerges...
Green steam emerges...
Red steam emerges...

This would indicate that you must pull the Violet Lever, then the Green Lever, and finally the Red Lever. It's important to note that you can have the same coloured lever more than once in a row, and the levers take 5 seconds to return back to their usable state. After successfully using the 3 levers, a Strangely Coloured Glooth will appear on the floor north of the levers. Use it to obtain a Vial of Coloured Glooth.

You fill some of the coloured glooth in a vessel. It seems to affect it, making it fragile. Better carry it somewhere safe.

Finally, take the Vial of Coloured Glooth back to Doubleday, be cautious when moving the Vial of Coloured Glooth as it will break, but regardless, Doubleday will acknowledge the task's completion. To report back to Doubleday, simply say Hi - Communications - Yes. As a reward, you'll earn 1 favor with Doubleday, which you can later Exchange for voting rights in the Rathleton Magistrate.

Probing

To begin the probing task, locate Doubleday in the Workshop Quarter here (33640, 31961, 6). Speak to him about helping him probe part of the sewers using the keywords Hi - Probe - Yes. Doubleday will give you a Mono Detector and a Strange Probing Device.

Avoid any unnecessary interactions with the Strange Probing Device. Moving it within a container or placing it in the wrong location will cause it to disappear. (However, you can freely move the container.) In the event that such an incident occurs, you can request a replacement device from Doubleday by inquiring about the Detector. However, please be aware that there is a mandatory waiting period of 30 minutes before you can receive a new device, starting from the time you initially obtained it. If you complete this task before 30 minutes have passed, you can obtain a new Strange Probing Device after you've handed in the previous successful printout.

To complete this task, you must utilize the Mono Detector to pinpoint specific abnormal spots within the Rathleton New Sewers. These locations can be found here (33639, 31896, 11). Be well-prepared to encounter a variety of challenging creatures in this area, including Glooth Anemones, Glooth Golems, Devourers, Rustheap Golems, Humongous Fungi, and Hideous Fungi. It is strongly advised to bring a Dwarven Ring to avoid becoming Drunk from the Humongous Fungi, and Hideous Fungi.

When you have located an abnormal spot, take the Strange Probing Device from your inventory and place it onto the ground at the abnormal spot. It will transform into an Active Probing Device. Next, quickly use the Active Probing Device while it is on the ground. If completed, you will receive a Crude Primitive Printout in your backpack.

Finally, take the Crude Primitive Printout back to Doubleday, he will acknowledge the task's completion. To report back to Doubleday, simply say Hi - Probe. As a reward, you'll earn 1 favor with Doubleday. He will also take the Crude Primitive Printout and, if you have it with you, the Mono Detector. These favors can be Exchanged for voting rights in the Rathleton Magistrate at a later time. Note: if you happen to have multiple Strange Probing Devices, you can use all of them at once for multiple favors; handing these Crude Primitive Printouts is not actually required.

Upon successful completion of this task, you will be eligible to acquire a Necrometer from Jondrin as part of the Dark Trails Quest. Otherwise, he will inform you that you are too inexperienced to wield such valuable government equipment.

Rathleton Turnip Party




































Browse Map (33703, 31965, 5)

Supply Crates
To Shallow Water

To begin Rathleton Turnip Party task, you may wish to locate Terrence in the Rathleton Workshops found here (33648, 31950, 7) using the keywords Hi - Supplies - Yes. However this is not necessary as you will start the task automatically when you gather 'use' a Supply Crate.

To begin, pass through the Rathleton Workshops where you will encounter Metal Gargoyles and Rustheap Golems, continue to head east to the Oramond Minotaur Camp found over the ramp here (33682, 31943, 7). Within this first part of the Oramond Minotaur Camp you will face Mooh'Tah Warriors, Worm Priestesses and Minotaur Hunters. Now that you're inside the camp make you way over to the ramp found here (33707, 31938, 7) to continue.

This first ramp will lead you to a relatively safe area which contains a Slime Slide which can teleport you back to the Depot in Rathleton if your world has voted for this shortcut, if they have not the Slime Slide will simply act as a 1sqm Protection Zone. Once you ascend the second ramp found here (33703, 31947, 6) be prepared to encounter Moohtants, Execowtioners, Minotaur Amazons, Mooh'Tah Warriors, Worm Priestesses and Minotaur Hunters.

On the mountain you will find Supply Crates. When you use a Supply Crate you will obtain a Supply Crate.
You feel as if being watched. Try to find a water source but don't throw the crate - put it in there gently and secretly.

Note: Do not move the Supply Crate within your inventory or drop it or it will be destroyed:
